extracted.intended_audience: CIA office heads, ADP customer/user offices and ADP service organizations preparing the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments required by OMB Circular A-79
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing office submissions to the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments (required by OMB Circular A-79). Covers what to include in Section I (new/revised ADP applications), Section II (ADP management accomplishments), and (when required) Section III (plans for the future).

rubrics_metrics.name: Report period and submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The report period is specified (e.g., the first half of fiscal year 1972 — July through December 1971). Offices must furnish their responses by the stated deadline (e.g., 24 January 1972).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare inputs covering the stated report period only. Meet the submission date provided by the coordinator; late inputs may affect the Agency's consolidated report to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification level of Agency report
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's report to the International Programs Division, OMB will be classified at the security level indicated by your submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure submitted material is marked/classified at the appropriate security level because that marking determines the classification of the Agency's consolidated report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Describe new and revised ADP applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section I should describe new and revised ADP applications — information normally furnished by ADP customer/user offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during the report period, 'Describe and explain the benefits' of the system. Provide enough detail for OMB to understand the change, its purpose, and its impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: System Description (what the system supports)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Starts, savings, and other benefits (manpower estimate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if performed manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an estimate of avoided personnel (people or man-years). Where possible, quantify time saved, reductions in required staff, or equivalent labor costs avoided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other benefits (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe concrete improvements (e.g., faster processing times, improved data accuracy, better timeliness of intelligence dissemination), and where possible quantify benefits or give examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II — ADP management accomplishments (overall)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section II should describe computer operations management accomplishments — information normally furnished by ADP service organizations such as OCS, ISD, CRS and AID (NPIC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe and explain the benefits of significant ADP operations/management accomplishments and provide supporting estimates of equipment, manpower or dollar impacts as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP management: standardization or integration of computer systems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Example accomplishment) Standardization or integration of computer system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain actions taken to standardize or integrate systems and describe resulting operational or cost benefits (e.g., reduced maintenance, interoperability gains).

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP management: improvements in ADP methods or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: (Example accomplishment) Improvements in ADP methods or technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe method/technology improvements (new procedures, tools, or tech adoption) and quantify benefits where possible (efficiency, capability enhancements).

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP management: negotiation of ADP contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: (Example accomplishment) Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document contract negotiations that yielded improved terms, cost savings, or performance guarantees; provide estimates of dollar or resource impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP management: progress on ADP security problems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Example accomplishment) Progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe security improvements, mitigations, or initiatives addressing vulnerabilities; include measurable outcomes where available (reduced incidents, patching metrics, compliance milestones).

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP management: research and development of advanced ADP systems
rubrics_metrics.description: (Example accomplishment) Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report R&D milestones, prototypes, or pilot programs and their expected operational or strategic benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II supporting estimates (equipment, manpower, dollar impacts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar (savings/impact) associated with Section II accomplishments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numerical estimates of equipment changes, manpower impacts (gains or reductions), and dollar savings or costs attributable to the management accomplishments described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section III — Plans for the future (when required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section III, regarding plans for the future, is a required component of the full report (but not required in this mid-fiscal year report).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When requested (e.g., full fiscal report), include planned ADP projects, anticipated benefits, timelines, resource estimates, and any dependencies or risks.
